title: feed_negotiation update_peer_groups does N sequential INSERTs
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/feed_negotiation.rs, update_peer_groups issues one INSERT per group inside a transaction. For a peer advertising many groups this serializes N round-trips to SQLite. Replace with a single bulk INSERT using VALUES (?1,?2),(?1,?3),... or executemany equivalent to reduce overhead.
